title: TypeSomething button (v2)
description: A bold pill button: acid lime with ink text, or an ink hairline outline. On hover it fills with ink, the text turns white and it lifts 2px (0.16s ease); focus adds a soft lime halo.
notes: the hover fill is the text colour, so on a dark panel it fills light
name: typesomething-v2-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: variant
props.description: primary: acid lime pill · outline: ink hairline pill on a clear ground

props.name: arrow
props.description: a small arrow after the label
